name: NewAdventure! Otome
source:
The scenery before you is unfamiliar, a serene landscape that takes your breath away. It seems out of this world, the completely mesmerizing sight makes you forget about one problem though.. where are you?

[From [url=https://teoeoeo.itch.io/newadventure-otome]Itch.io[/url]]
translation:
眼前的景致陌生而静谧，美得令人屏息。这片宛如世外桃源般的迷人风光彻底攫住了你的心神，甚至让你一时忘却了一个关键问题……你究竟身在何处？

[摘自[url=https://teoeoeo.itch.io/newadventure-otome]itch.io[/url]]
